links.outcome: MCQ accuracy of customized otolaryngology LLM versus general LLMs and otolaryngologists
links.effect: E-GPT-A overall accuracy 74.6% vs GPT-3.5 60.4%, Claude 2.0 61.7%, Claude 2.1 60.8%, GPT-4 68.3%; otolaryngologists and trainees averaged 71.1%. Lower in pediatrics (62.5%) and facial plastics (67.5%).
links.quote: E-GPT-A achieved an overall accuracy of 74.6%, outperforming GPT-3.5 (60.4%), Claude 2.0 (61.7%), Claude 2.1 (60.8%), and GPT-4 (68.3%).

unlisted_practices: Domain-specific customization of LLM with targeted instructions for a medical specialty

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of a customized GPT assistant versus baseline LLMs on otolaryngology multiple-choice exam questions without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or clinical workflow practice.
